The New Generation Alen BreatheSmart 75i: Ultimate Air Purification for Large Spaces

Designed to tackle serious air quality concerns, the BreatheSmart 75i combines powerful performance, quiet operation, and intelligent features to provide clean, healthy air for large areas up to 2,800 sq ft. Here’s why it’s the top choice for your space:

Advanced Filtration: The True HEPA H13 filter captures 99.9% of airborne particles down to 0.1 microns, ideal for managing allergens, dust, smoke, and odors. With a robust 350 CADR, it delivers fast, effective purification.
Expansive Coverage: Capable of purifying up to 2,800 sq ft every hour or 1,400 sq ft every 30 minutes, making it perfect for open-plan spaces, large bedrooms, and living areas.
Ultra-Quiet Performance: Enjoy powerful air cleaning at whisper-quiet levels. With a maximum sound level of only 51 dB, the 75i ensures a restful, uninterrupted environment.
Smart Monitoring & Notifications: Equipped with advanced sensors to track PM 2.5, VOCs, CO2, temperature, and humidity. Set personalized air quality notifications via the Alen Air app to stay informed and in control.
Detailed Control & Scheduling: The Alen Air app allows you to manage multiple purifiers, adjust settings, and create custom schedules that fit your daily routines—ensuring fresh air whenever you need it.
Smart Filters: Track filter life seamlessly, even when swapping filters. The 75i remembers remaining filter life, offering hassle-free maintenance.
Auto Light Mode: The purifier’s lights adjust automatically to ambient lighting, dimming when it’s dark to maintain a restful atmosphere.
Future-Ready with Firmware Updates: Get ongoing enhancements directly through the Alen Air app, ensuring your 75i stays up to date with the latest features.

With its sleek design and customizable panels, the Alen BreatheSmart 75i combines style with top-tier purification technology to seamlessly fit any décor. Plus, it’s backed by Alen’s Forever Guarantee, providing peace of mind and premium performance for life.

Q&A

Allen is sending replacement for original BreathSmart. How do I discard old one? Does it go to hazardous waste or in recycle bin or regular trash?
Hi Eileen, Thank you for your question. Filters cannot be recycled, these need to be disposed in regular trash. Thank you for choosing Alen!
I have an HVAC system that is brand new. Does this help with the quality of the air and how does it compare to an air purifier?
Alen Air Purifiers will help purify the air in addition to any filter your HVAC system might use. HVAC systems often use MERV filters, which is the acronym for Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value, a measure of a filter's ability to capture larger particles between 0.3 & 10 microns. MERV ratings primarily pertain to home AC/Furnace systems. The Alen BreatheSmart 75i uses True HEPA (H13) filters, which capture 99.99% of airborne particles as small as 0.1 microns in size (including aerosolized viruses). HEPA stands for High-Efficiency Particulate Air Filter. HEPA air filters are composed of fibrous or porous materials that remove solid particulates such as dust, pollen, mold, and bacteria from the air.
How and when should I use the ionizer mode on my BreatheSmart 75i? Is the ozone produced by the ionizer dangerous? What are the possible side affects?
Alen air purifiers utilize ozone-safe ionizers that are California Air Resources Board-certified to produce ozone emission concentrations of less than 0.050 parts per million. Based on this certification, we can confidently say the ionizer is safe to use in your home. However, you can turn it on and off to use as often or infrequently as you wish. For more information about Ionizers, please see the link below: support.alen.com/hc/en-us/articles/13459719801876-What-is-an-Ionizer

Probably a stupid question---We purchased this air purifier earlier this year. The filter has clear plastic over it. Are we supposed to remove it?
Yes! All of our filters are sealed in plastic to protect them from the elements, and the plastic should be removed prior to use.
I received a gray pouch with my 75i that doesn't look like packaging. It's about 7"x5"x2" and has a grommet in one corner. It's not listed above as something in the box. What is this?
The gray sachets contain activated carbon to help absorb any new plastic smells from the purifier. You are welcome to keep and use them safely throughout the home to help absorb odors in other areas, then discard them at your convenience.
